## Methods {background-color="#000F46" .center}

---

## Code — R Example

```{.r}
library(tidyverse)

data |>
  filter(year >= 2020) |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(outcome, na.rm = TRUE),
    n          = n()
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(region, mean_value, fill = region)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#000F46", "#00A9CE", "#47C8F0", "#8389A5")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Outcome by Region",
    x = NULL, y = "Mean value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Lato")
```

---

## Code — Python Example

```{.python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

UOM_PALETTE = ["#000F46", "#00A9CE", "#47C8F0", "#8389A5"]

df = pd.read_csv("data.csv")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
df.groupby("region")["outcome"].mean().plot(
    kind="bar", ax=ax, color=UOM_PALETTE
)
ax.set_title("Mean Outcome by Region", fontsize=14)
ax.set_xlabel("")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("fig_results.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
```

## Embedding Space (3D)

<!--
A genuine 3D plot (not a CSS trick) — good for embeddings, PCA/UMAP/t-SNE
projections, or any point cloud where depth carries real information.
Interactive: drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, works in both the live deck
and a browser-opened export.

Requires R with the `plotly` package (installs `htmlwidgets`/`crosstalk` as
dependencies) at render time — this is the one slide in the template with a
real R dependency; every other "code" slide just displays code as text.
Delete this slide if you don't need a 3D plot, or swap the iris/PCA data
below for your own embeddings (any data frame with 3 numeric columns plus
a colour/cluster column works).
-->

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(plotly)

pca <- prcomp(iris[, 1:4], scale. = TRUE)
embed <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:3])
embed$species <- iris$Species

plot_ly(
  embed, x = ~PC1, y = ~PC2, z = ~PC3,
  color = ~species,
  colors = c("#000F46", "#00A9CE", "#8389A5"),
  marker = list(size = 4, opacity = 0.85)
) |>
  add_markers() |>
  layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "Dim 1", backgroundcolor = "white", gridcolor = "#E0E0E0"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Dim 2", backgroundcolor = "white", gridcolor = "#E0E0E0"),
      zaxis = list(title = "Dim 3", backgroundcolor = "white", gridcolor = "#E0E0E0")
    ),
    font = list(family = "Lato, sans-serif", color = "#222222", size = 12),
    legend = list(font = list(family = "Lato, sans-serif")),
    margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0)
  )
```
